title: Turlock Historical Society Museum
gap: Prices, hours and eligibility are not copied here yet. We will ask when you request.
blurb: We are a non-profit society, formed in 1994, funded totally by membership dues and donations. The museum is staffed by volunteers who donate their time to make sure the museum is open for the public to enjoy. Admission to our museum is free and we are open Saturdays from 9:00 a.m. to 5:00 p.m. The Society's Mission Statement focuses on the preservation and sharing of Turlock's history.
